title: Provably Safe, Yet Scalable Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.14536v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn policies that optimize rewards while satisfying constraints. Predominant approaches rely on soft-constrained policy optimization, which has achieved empirical success but does not provide formal safety guarantees for the learned policy. In contrast, methods with strict guarantees typically rely on explicit certificate functions, whose construction requires the direct synthesis and verification of control-invariant sets, a process that scales poorly with state dimension and often yields overly conservative behavior. In this paper, we present the Provably Safe, yet Scalable RL (PS2-RL) framework, a novel two-phase architecture for learning provably safe policies in a scalable manner, designed to overcome the key bottlenecks of prior methods. translated_title: 可证明安全且可扩展的强化学习
translated_abstract: 安全强化学习（RL）旨在学习在满足约束条件的同时优化奖励的策略。主流方法依赖于软约束策略优化，这类方法在实证上取得了成功，但无法为学习到的策略提供正式的安全保证。相比之下，具有严格保证的方法通常依赖于显式证书函数，其构建需要直接合成和验证控制不变集，这一过程随状态维度的增加扩展性较差，且往往导致过于保守的行为。在本文中，我们提出了可证明安全且可扩展的强化学习框架（PS2-RL），这是一种新颖的两阶段架构，用于以可扩展的方式学习可证明安全的策略，旨在克服先前方法的关键瓶颈。PS2-RL并不显式计算不变集，而是利用学习到的备份策略对系统动力学进行前向积分，从而生成一个隐式的……
tldr: PS2-RL框架通过两阶段架构和学习的备份策略进行前向积分来隐式构造安全保证，在提供严格安全可证明性的同时，实现了随状态维度良好扩展的安全强化学习。
en_tdlr: The PS2-RL framework learns provably safe policies through a novel two-phase architecture that implicitly generates safety guarantees via a learned backup policy, overcoming the poor scalability and conservatism of explicit certificate-based methods.
